summary.value: Magnolia Bakery is the original 1996 bakery at 401 Bleecker Street on the corner of West 11th Street, a small West Village shop famous for cupcakes and banana pudding. Restaurantji diners rate it 4 774 ratings and say The banana pudding here is simply amazing and is one of the best desserts in the city hands down. It suits a sweet stop on a Village walk; expect a line in the evening.

description.value: Magnolia Bakery opened its first store in NYC’s West Village neighborhood on the corner of Bleecker Street and West 11th Street in 1996. The original shop is at 401 Bleecker St, New York, NY 10014. Come for a cupcake or the famous banana pudding, and expect a line in the evening. Restaurantji lists the 401 Bleecker Street bakery at 4 from 774 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “The banana pudding here is simply amazing”; “Staff is always great”. itineraryNote: Magnolia Bakery: the original pink-and-white West Village bakery; grab banana pudding and a cupcake for a Bleecker Street stroll.
review1: Magnolia's banana pudding is the hero of the menu, widely ranked as one of the best desserts in the city hands down and the main reason to make a stop at the bakery.
review2: It is a hit with families, with children loving both the flavors and the shop itself, which makes it an easy sweet stop to fit into a day of sightseeing with kids.
review3: Regulars describe it as always delicious, a dependable treat whenever they pass by, with the consistency of the banana pudding and baked goods keeping it on their regular rotation of neighborhood stops.
review4: Friendly staff round out the experience, with the team described as consistently great, so even busy moments at the counter tend to stay pleasant and orders move along without much fuss.
